semantics: CURRENT NFL quarterback ability through Week 7, 2026; stable peer-calibrated grading, not career fame, fantasy production, draft status or future breakout odds.
population: Five players already in current 32-team NFL Wheel priority and immutable 594-person GM historical population.

A limited 2026 sample and pressure volatility prevent grading this as a high-end 87+ starter. 83 reflects credible present starter ability, not projected ceiling.
